issues.on_page: State revenues: General 274,678 + Street 310,484 + Debt Service 28,168; budget schedule p13 Homestead exemption/property tax relief 114,700, Prorate 1,387
issues.issue: Homestead exemption, Property Tax Credit and pro-rate are never meant to sit inside state aid. A partial breakdown does tie exactly: homestead/property tax relief 114,700 = General Homestead 50,701 + Property tax relief 35,831 (p15) + Debt Service State revenues 28,168. But the General Fund remainder does not reconcile to the printed pieces, so keeping the line whole is defensible. Flag for the user.

The statement (p6) shows General Fund federal revenues of only 117,773 (other intergovernmental 81,502). The Statement of Activities (p2) shows 178,596 as Economic Development capital grants. Grants is probably a mix of federal and other grants.

issues.on_page: accrual-basis figures, e.g. Electric charges for services 2,436,259 vs 2,417,406 on the modified-cash statement (p10); total operating expenses 2,761,418 vs 2,751,481
issues.issue: The business-type detail comes from the accrual-basis supplementary statement, so it does not tie to the modified-cash proprietary statement that business-type receipts and disbursements are taken from. That is a defensible choice (it is a supplementary schedule), but the two bases differ.
